honesty: Truthfulness in word and deed. Lies, cheating, and theft lower it; keeping your word and owning mistakes raise it.
compassion: Care for the suffering of others, human or animal. Kindness raises it; cruelty and indifference lower it.
humility: Freedom from boasting and from needing to be seen. Quiet service raises it; bragging and demanding honor lower it.
justice: Fair dealing and standing up for the wronged. Righting a wrong raises it; taking advantage of the weak lowers it.
curiosity: The urge to look closer, ask, and go where nobody sent you. Exploring, questioning, and experimenting raise it.
mischief: Pranks, provocations, and delight in disorder. Rises with every trick played and every rule bent for fun.
generosity: Giving without being asked and without expecting return. Sharing raises it; hoarding and haggling hard lower it.
